Each of the questions below consists of a question and two statements numbered I and II given below it. You have to decide whether the data provided in which of the statements are sufficient to answer the question. Choose your answer from the options based on this.
In which direction is the cow with respect to the goat?
I. The cow is standing to the west of the Ox, which is standing to the north of the goat.
II. The goat is standing to the east of the camel, which is standing to the south of the cow.
o: If the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question, while the data in statement II alone are not sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question, while the data in statement I alone are not sufficient to answer the question.
If the data either in statement I alone or in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in both the statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
e: From either of the statements, the cow is standing to the north-west of the goat.
h:
नीचे दिए गए प्रत्येक प्रश्न में एक प्रश्न और उसके नीचे दो कथन संख्यांकित I और II दिए गए हैं| आपको निर्धारित करना है कि कथन में उपलब्ध सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है अथवा नहीं| इस पर आधारित विकल्पों से अपने उत्तर का चयन करें|
बकरी के संबंध में गाय किस दिशा में है?
I. गाय, बैल के पश्चिम में खड़ी है, जो बकरी के उत्तर में खड़ा है|
II.बकरी, ऊंट के पूर्व में खड़ी है, जो गाय के दक्षिण में खड़ा है|
oh: यदि अकेले कथन I में उपलब्ध सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है, जबकि अकेले कथन II में उपलब्ध सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है|
यदि अकेले कथन II में उपलब्ध सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है, जबकि अकेले कथन I में उपलब्ध सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है|
यदि या तो अकेले कथन I या अकेले कथन II में उपलब्ध सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है|
यदि दोनों कथनों I और II में उपलब्ध सूचना संयुक्त रूप से प्रश्न के उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है|

t:
A question is given, followed by two statements numbered (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and select the appropriate answer.
Six persons are sitting in two parallel rows with 3 people in each row in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. P, Q and R sit in row 1 facing the south direction and M, N and O sit in row 2 facing the north direction. Who sits opposite to O?
Statement I: N sits opposite to Q. R sits immediate right of P. N sits second to the left of M.
Statement II: Only one person sits between M and O. P sits adjacent to Q and R.
o: Data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question.
Data in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not.
e: Six persons are sitting in two parallel rows with 3 people in each row in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. P, Q and R sit in row 1 facing the south direction and M, N and O sit in row 2 facing the north direction. Who sits opposite to O? Statement I: N sits opposite to Q. R sits immediate right of P. N sits second to the left of M. R sits opposite to O. Statement II: Only one person sits between M and O. P sits adjacent to Q and R. So, statement II alone is not sufficient. Hence, Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.
h:
एक प्रश्न दिया गया है जिसके बाद दो कथन क्रमांकित (I) और (II) दिए गए हैं। आपको यह निर्धारित करना है कि कथनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़िए और उपयुक्त उत्तर का चयन कीजिए।
छह व्यक्ति दो समानांतर पंक्तियों में प्रत्येक पंक्ति में 3 व्यक्तियों के साथ इस प्रकार बैठे हैं कि आसन्न व्यक्तियों के बीच समान दूरी है। P, Q और R पंक्ति 1 में दक्षिण दिशा की ओर मुखरित होकर बैठे हैं तथा M, N और O पंक्ति 2 में उत्तर दिशा की ओर मुखरित होकर बैठे हैं। O के विपरीत कौन बैठा है?
कथन I: N, Q के विपरीत बैठा है। R, P के निकटस्थ दाईं ओर बैठा है। N, M के बाएँ से दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है।
कथन II: M और O के बीच में केवल एक व्यक्ति बैठा है। P, Q और R के आसन्न बैठा है।
oh: एक साथ कथन I और II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।
या तो अकेले कथन I या अकेले कथन II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।
अकेले कथन I में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन II में दी गई सूचना पार्यप्त नहीं है।
अकेले कथन II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन I में दी गई सूचना पार्यप्त नहीं है।

t:
A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.
Question:
A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table. Each of them faces either the center of the table or outside (i.e., opposite to the center). In which direction is D facing?
Statements:
(I) B sits second to the right of F and both are facing the center. Only two people are sitting between A and E from the either side. Both A and E are facing the same direction. A is not an immediate neighbor of B.
(II) C is facing the opposite direction of B. D is sitting to the second left of C.
o: Statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not.
Statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not.
e: Statement I alone: Information about only 4 persons A, B, E, and F is given. No information is given about the position and direction of D. Statement I alone is not sufficient. Statement II alone: C is facing the opposite direction of B. D is sitting to the second left of C. But we are not given any information about the direction of D. Statement II alone is not sufficient. Statements I and II together: We cannot determine the direction in which D faces. Hence, statements I and II together are not sufficient.
h: एक प्रश्न दिया गया है, जिसके बाद दो कथन संख्यांकित I और II दिये गये हैं। पहचान कीजिये कि कौन-सा/से कथन प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है/हैं? प्रश्न: A, B, C, D, E और F एक वृत्ताकार मेज के इर्द-गिर्द बैठे हैं। उनमें से प्रत्येक व्यक्ति या तो मेज के केंद्र की ओर मुखरित है या बाहर की ओर (अर्थात, केंद्र के विपरीत) मुखरित है। D किस दिशा की ओर मुखरित है? कथन : (I) B, F के दाईं ओर से दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है और दोनों केंद्र की ओर मुखरित हैं। दोनों ओर से A और E के बीच केवल दो व्यक्ति बैठे हैं। A और E दोनों समान दिशा की ओर मुखरित हैं। A, B का निकटस्थ पड़ोसी नहीं है। (II) C, B के विपरीत दिशा की ओर मुखरित है। D, C के बाईं ओर से दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है।
oh: एक साथ कथन I और II प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं हैं।
अकेले कथन II प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है, जबकि कथन I पर्याप्त नहीं है।
एक साथ कथन I और II प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं।
अकेले कथन I प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है, जबकि कथन II पर्याप्त नहीं है।

t: The question below consists of two statements numbered I and II given below it. You have to decide whether the data given in the statements are sufficient to answer the questions. Seven flags P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are in a ground at a certain direction from each other. The flag P is in which direction with respect to flag S ? Statement I: Flag V is to the north of Q, which is to the west of R. Flag T is to the north of S. Flag P is exactly between U and V. Statement II: Flag U is to the west of V. Flag R is exactly between T and S. T is to the east of V.
o: If the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question, while the data in statement II alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question, while the data in statement I alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in both statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question
If the data given in both statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question
e: It is given that, Seven flags P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are in a ground at a certain direction from each other. Statement I, Flag V is to the north of Q, which is to the west of R. Flag T is to the north of S. Flag P is exactly between U and V. Here, the position of P is not defined. Hence, statement I alone is not sufficient. Statement II, Flag U is to the west of V. Flag R is exactly between T and S. T is to the east of V. We do not have further information hence statement II alone is not sufficient. From statements I and II, Flag V is to the north of Q which is to the west of R. Flag T is to the north of S. Flag R is exactly between T and S. Flag U is to the west of V. Flag P is exactly between U and V. T is to the east of V. We get, Here, flag P is to the north-west of flag S. Hence, the data in both statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question.
h: नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न में दो कथन I और II दिए गए हैं। आपको यह निर्धारित करना होगा कि कथन में दी गयी सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं या नहीं। सात झंडे P, Q, R, S, T, U और V एक दूसरे से एक निश्चित दिशा में एक मैदान में है। झंडा P झंडा S के संबंध में किस दिशा में है? कथन I: झंडा V, Q के उत्तर में है, जो R के पश्चिम में है। झंडा T, S से उत्तर की दिशा में है। झंडा P, U और V के ठीक बीच में है। कथन II: झंडा U, V के पश्चिम में है। झंडा R, T और S के ठीक बीच में है। T, V के पूर्व में है।
oh: यदि अकेले कथन I में दी गयी जानकारी इस प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं, जबकि अकेले कथन II में दी गयी जानकारी इस प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं हैं।
यदि अकेले कथन II में दी गयी जानकारी इस प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं, जबकि अकेले कथन I में दी गयी जानकारी इस प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं हैं।
यदि दोनों कथनों I और II में दी गयी जानकारी एक साथ इस प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए आवश्यक हैं।
यदि दोनों कथनों I व II में दी गयी जानकारी एक साथ इस प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिये पर्याप्त नहीं हैं ।

t:
Two statements numbered I and II are given below. You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements are sufficient to answer the question.
There are five friends A, B, C, D and E standing in different directions with respect to each other. Towards which direction is Person D with respect to Person B?
I. Person C is to the east of person D and to the north of person E, who is to the north of person B.
II. Person D is to the north of person A, who is to the east of person E. Person E is to the west of person B.
o: If the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question while the data in statement II alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in both the statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data either in statement I or Statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question
If the data in both statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question
e: Only statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question. Detailed solution Using Statement I alone: I. Person C is to the east of person D and to the north of person E, who is to the North of person B. So, Person D is in North-west direction with respect to B. Using Statement II alone: II. Person D is to the north of person A, who is to the east of person E. Person E is to the west of person B. So, there are two possible cases i.e. Case 1 and Case 2. So, the direction of person D with respect to person B is not known.
h:
नीचे दो कथन क्रमांकित I और II दिए गए हैं। आपको यह निर्धारित करना है कि कथनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं।
पाँच मित्र A, B, C, D और E एक दूसरे के सन्दर्भ में अलग-अलग दिशाओं में खड़े हैं। व्यक्ति B के सन्दर्भ में व्यक्ति D किस दिशा की ओर है?
I. व्यक्ति C, व्यक्ति D के पूर्व में और व्यक्ति E के उत्तर में है और व्यक्ति E, व्यक्ति B के उत्तर में है।
II. व्यक्ति D, व्यक्ति A के उत्तर में है और व्यक्ति A, व्यक्ति E के पूर्व में है। व्यक्ति E, व्यक्ति B के पश्चिम में है।
oh: यदि अकेले कथन I में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि अकेले कथन II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
यदि एक साथ कथन I और II दोनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
यदि अकेले या तो कथन I या कथन II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।
यदि एक साथ कथन I और II दोनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए आवश्यक है।

Given below is a question followed by two statements I and II. Read both statements carefully to decide which one of them is sufficient to answer the question.
Six people - A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a straight line facing north. Who sits to the immediate left of D?
(I) A sits second from one of the extreme ends of the line. Only two people sit between A and B. E sits to the immediate right of C.
(II) C sits third from the left end of the line. Only one person sits between C and F. E sits third to the right of F.
o: Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not.
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.
Data in statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
e: Six people - A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a straight line facing north. (I) A sits second from one of the extreme ends of the line. Only two people sit between A and B. E sits to the immediate right of C. (II) C sits third from the left end of the line. Only one person sits between C and F. E sits third to the right of F. Combining both Statement I and II: (I) A sits second from one of the extreme ends of the line. Only two people sit between A and B. E sits to the immediate right of C. (II) C sits third from the left end of the line. Only one person sits between C and F. E sits third to the right of F. So, Data in statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
h:
नीचे एक प्रश्न दिया गया है जिसके बाद दो कथन I और II दिए गए हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और निर्धारित कीजिए कि उनमें से कौन-सा/से कथन प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है/हैं।
छह व्यक्ति - A, B, C, D, E और F एक सीधी पंक्ति में उत्तर की ओर मुखरित होकर बैठे हैं। D के निकटस्थ बाईं ओर कौन बैठा है?
(I) A पंक्ति के किसी एक चरम छोर से दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। A और B के बीच केवल दो व्यक्ति बैठे हैं। E, C के निकटस्थ दाईं ओर बैठा है।
(II) C पंक्ति के बाएँ छोर से तीसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। C और F के बीच केवल एक व्यक्ति बैठा है। E, F के दाईं ओर से तीसरे स्थान पर बैठा है।
oh: अकेले कथन II की सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन I की सूचना पर्याप्त नहीं है।
अकेले कथन I की सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन II की सूचना पर्याप्त नहीं है।
एक साथ कथन I और II की सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
एक साथ कथन I और II की सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।

A question is given, followed by two statements numbered (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and select the appropriate answer.
Question: Four people, A, B, C and D, are sitting in a straight line, facing south. Who is sitting at the right end?
Statements:
(I) Only two people sit between B and D; A sits to the immediate left of B.
(II) Only one person sits between B and C; A sits to the immediate right of C.
o: Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not
Data in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question
Data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question

oh: अकेले कथन I में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन II में दी गई सूचना पर्याप्त नहीं है।

(I) K sits to the immediate right of P. Only two people sit between P and Q. R sits second to the right of M.

o: Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not.
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.

Data in statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
e: Six people - K, M, N, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. (I) K sits to the immediate right of P. Only two people sit between P and Q. R sits second to the right of M. So, R sits second to the left of P. (II) Only two people sit between N and M. Q is an immediate neighbour of M. Only one person sits between Q and K. So, who sits second to the left of P is not known. Thus, data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.
h:

oh: अकेले कथन II की सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन I की सूचना पर्याप्त नहीं है।
अकेले कथन I की सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन II की सूचना पर्याप्त नहीं है।

Two statements numbered I and II are given below. You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements are sufficient to answer the question.
Four persons are sitting in a linear row facing south. Four other persons are sitting in another linear row facing north. The two rows are parallel to each other and each person of one row is facing a person from the other row. Who is sitting to the immediate left of H?
I. B is sitting to the left of G. D is sitting to the immediate left of C. J is facing D. C is sitting at a corner. A is sitting second to the right of K.
II. J is sitting to the immediate left of K. D is sitting second to the right of B. A is facing G. G is sitting second to the left of C.
o: If the data in both statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question while the data in statement I alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data either in statement I alone or in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question
If the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question while the data in statement II alone are not sufficient to answer the question
e: From I alone: D is sitting to the immediate left of C. J is facing D. C is sitting at a corner. B is sitting to the left of G. A is sitting second to the right of K. The eighth person must be H. In either case, A is sitting to the immediate left of H. Statement I alone is sufficient. From II alone: A is facing G. G is sitting second to the left of C. Let us assume that A is facing north. J is sitting to the immediate left of K. D is sitting second to the right of B. It cannot be determined who is sitting to the immediate left of H. Statement II alone is not sufficient.
h:
नीचे दो कथन संख्यांकित I और II दिए गए हैं। आपको यह निर्धारित करना है कि कथनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं।
चार व्यक्ति एक रैखिक पंक्ति में दक्षिण की ओर मुखरित होकर बैठे हैं। चार अन्य व्यक्ति एक अन्य रैखिक पंक्ति में उत्तर की ओर मुखरित होकर बैठे हैं। दो पंक्तियाँ एक दूसरे के समानांतर हैं और एक पंक्ति का प्रत्येक व्यक्ति दूसरी पंक्ति के एक व्यक्ति की ओर मुखरित है। H के निकटस्थ बाईं ओर कौन बैठा है?
I. B, G के बाईं ओर बैठा है। D, C के निकटस्थ बाईं ओर बैठा है। J, D की ओर मुखरित है। C किसी कोने पर बैठा है। A, K के दाएँ से दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है।
II. J, K के निकटस्थ बाईं ओर बैठा है। D, B के दाएँ से दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। A, G की ओर मुखरित है। G, C के बाएँ से दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है।
oh: यदि एक साथ कथन I और II दोनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
यदि अकेले कथन II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि अकेले कथन I में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
यदि या तो अकेले कथन I या अकेले कथन II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।
यदि अकेले कथन I में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि अकेले कथन II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।

A question is given followed by two statements (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and select the appropriate answer.
Question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing centre, but not necessarily in the same order. Four persons are sitting at corners and four on middle sides. A and F are sitting at the corners. H is not sitting at the corner. How many persons are sitting between A and H when counted in the clockwise direction from A?
Statements:
(I) C is to the second right of H. G is to the second right of A.
(II) D is facing H. A is facing B, who is to the immediate left of C.
o: Data in statement I and statement II together is not sufficient to answer the question
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not
Data in statement I and statement II together is sufficient to answer the question
Data in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question
e: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table facing centre, but not necessarily in the same order. A and F are sitting at the corners. H is not sitting at the corner. Statement I: C is to the second right of H. G is to the second right of A. No definite arrangement can be established. So, statement I alone is not sufficient. Statement II: D is facing H. A is facing B, who is to the immediate left of C. So, either none or four persons are sitting between A and H when counted in the clockwise direction from A. So, statement II alone is not sufficient. By combining I and II: D is facing H. A is facing B, who is to the immediate left of C. C is to the second right of H. G is to the second right of A. F is sitting at the corner. So, four persons are sitting between A and H when counted in the clockwise direction from A. Thus, statements I and II together are sufficient.
h:
एक प्रश्न का अनुसरण करते हुए दो कथन (I) और (II) दिए गए हैं। आपको यह निर्धारित करना है कि कथनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़ें और उपयुक्त उत्तर का चयन करें।

कथन :
(I) C, H के दायें से दूसरे स्थान पर है। G, A के दायें से दूसरे स्थान पर है।
(II) D, H की ओर मुखरित है। A , B की ओर मुखरित है और B, C के निकटस्थ बाईं ओर है।
oh: कथन I और कथन II की सूचना एक साथ प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है
अकेले कथन II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन I में दी गई सूचना पर्याप्त नहीं है

या तो कथन I अकेले या कथन II अकेले दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है

A question and two statements numbered I and II are given below. You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements are sufficient to answer the question.
Six people - John, Mohan, Rohan, Geeta, Seeta and Meena are sitting around a circular table and all are facing the centre. What is the position of Geeta with respect to Rohan?
Statement I: Mohan stands second to the right of Geeta. Only one person stands between Mohan and Meena. Rohan is an immediate neighbor of Geeta.
Statement II: Only two people are sitting between Geeta and Seeta. Seeta is an immediate neighbor of both Meena and Mohan. Seeta is sitting immediate right of Mohan. Rohan is not an immediate neighbor of Meena.
o: If the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question while the data in statement II alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in both the statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data either in statement I or statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question while the data in statement I alone are not sufficient to answer the question
e: Using Statement I alone: Mohan stands second to the right of Geeta. Only one person stands between Mohan and Meena. Rohan is an immediate neighbor of Geeta. So, there are two cases possible i.e. Case 1 and Case 2. So, the position of Geeta with respect to Rohan is not known. Using Statement II alone: Only two people are sitting between Geeta and Seeta. Seeta is an immediate neighbor of both Meena and Mohan. Seeta is sitting immediate right of Mohan. Rohan is not an immediate neighbor of Meena. So, the position of Geeta with respect to Rohan is known i.e. Geeta sits immediate left of Rohan. Only statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.
h:

oh: यदि अकेले कथन I में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि अकेले कथन II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।

Seven person namely - Gappu, Monty, Mintu, Sintu, Roli, Jeni and Sonty are sitting in a row facing north. Not necessarily in the same order. How many person sits between Jeni and Sonty?
I. Gappu sits third to left of Roli. Only two person sits between Sintu and Mintu. Monty sits second to left of Jeni. Mintu and Roli sits together. Monty sits at one of the ends of the row.
II. Sintu sits fourth to right of Jeni, either of them sits at end of the row. Monty sits second to left of Jeni. Only two person sits between Gappu and Roli. Mintu sits third to left of Sintu.
o: If the data in Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question, while the data in Statement II alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question, while the data in Statement I alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
If the data either in Statement I alone or in Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in both the Statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question.
e: From I: We have: • Gappu sits third to left of Roli. • Mintu and Roli sits together. • Only two person sits between Sintu and Mintu. • Monty sits second to left of Jeni. Monty sits at one of the ends of the row. Based on above given information we have: Clearly, only two person sits between Jeni and Sonty. Hence, statement I alone is sufficient. From II: We have: • Sintu sits fourth to right of Jeni, either of them sits at end of the row. • Monty sits second to left of Jeni, that means Sintu sits at extreme right end. • Mintu sits third to left of Sintu. • Only two person sits between Gappu and Roli, that means Sonty sits immediate left of Sintu. Based on above given information we have: Clearly, only two person sits between Jeni and Sonty. Hence, statement II alone is sufficient. Thus, answer is option (c).

Six people - K, M, N, P, Q and R are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Who sits to the immediate right of K?
Statement I: K sits third to the left of M. Only one person sits between K and N. R sits to the immediate left of N.
Statement II: K sits second to the right of Q. Only two people sit between K and M. P sits second to the left of R.
o: Data in statement I alone is sufficient
Either data in statement I or II is sufficient
Data in statements I and II together are sufficient
Data in statement II alone is sufficient
e: Both statements independently lead to the same unique arrangement where R sits immediately to the right of K - each statement alone is enough on its own to fix the full circle.
h:

कथन I: K, M के बाईं ओर तीसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। K और N के बीच केवल एक व्यक्ति बैठा है। R, N के ठीक बाईं ओर बैठा है।
कथन II: K, Q के दाईं ओर दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। K और M के बीच केवल दो व्यक्ति बैठे हैं। P, R के बाईं ओर दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है।
oh: केवल कथन I में दिया डेटा पर्याप्त है

Six people - A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a straight line facing north. Who sits to the immediate left of D?
Statement I: A sits second from one of the extreme ends of the line. Only two people sit between A and B. E sits to the immediate right of C.
Statement II: C sits third from the left end of the line. Only one person sits between C and F. E sits third to the right of F.
o: Data in statement II alone is sufficient
Data in statement I alone is sufficient
Data in statements I and II together are not sufficient
Data in statements I and II together are sufficient
e: Even after combining both statements, two mirror-image seating possibilities remain valid, and in each, a different person (A or B) sits to D's left - so it can never be uniquely determined.
h:
छह लोग - A, B, C, D, E और F एक सीधी रेखा में उत्तर की ओर मुख करके बैठे हैं। D के ठीक बाईं ओर कौन बैठा है?
कथन I: A, रेखा के किसी एक छोर से दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। A और B के बीच केवल दो व्यक्ति बैठे हैं। E, C के ठीक दाईं ओर बैठा है।
कथन II: C, रेखा के बाएं छोर से तीसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। C और F के बीच केवल एक व्यक्ति बैठा है। E, F के दाईं ओर तीसरे स्थान पर बैठा है।

कथन I और II मिलकर भी पर्याप्त नहीं हैं
कथन I और II दोनों का डेटा मिलकर पर्याप्त है

Data in statements I and II together are sufficient
e: Statement I alone gives enough clues (K's position, gap between P & Q, R relative to M) to fully fix the circular arrangement. Statement II alone leaves multiple valid arrangements, so it's insufficient by itself.

o: Data in statement (II) alone is sufficient to answer the question, whereas data in statement (I) alone is not
Data in statements (I) and (II) together are not sufficient to answer the question.

e: Shourya delivered parcels to five locations A, B, C, D and E while prioritising delivery of heavier parcels first. Only Statement I: (I) The parcel for location C was heavier than all other parcels. C > _ > _ > _ > _ Which location was delivered in the end is not known. Only Statement II: (II) The parcel for location D was lighter than the parcels assigned to locations B and A A/B > D Which location was delivered in the end is not known. Both Statement I and II: (I) The parcel for location C was heavier than all other parcels (II) The parcel for location D was lighter than the parcels assigned to locations B and A Which location was delivered in the end is not known. Box D is kept at composite numbered position. Two boxes are kept between C and D. S was born before T. So, no definite arrangement can be established. So, statement I alone is not sufficient. Statement II : W was born immediate after S. Y was not born on Sunday. Thus, case 4, case 5 and case 6 will be invalid. So, no definite arrangement can be established. So, statement II alone is not sufficient. अकेले या तो कथन I या कथन II में दिया गया आंकड़ा प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।
केवल कथन I में दिया गया आंकड़ा प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन II में दिया गया आंकड़ा अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
केवल कथन II में दिया गया आंकड़ा प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन I में दिया गया आंकड़ा अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।

The question below consists of a question and two statements numbered I and II given below it. You have to decide whether the data given in the statements are sufficient to answer the question.
Six friends D, E, F, G, H and I were born in different months among May, June and July of either 2003 or 2004. When was F born?
Statement I: F and I were born in the same year. I was born in June 2003. Not more than three people were born after F.
Statement II: Only one friend was born in between H and G. No person was born in between F and H and they were not born in the same year. No person was born in between D and H.
o: If the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question, while the data in statement II alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question, while the data in statement I alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in both statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question
If the data given in both statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question
e: It is given that, Six friends D, E, F, G, H and I were born in different months among May, June and July of either 2003 or 2004. Statement I, F and I were born in the same year. I was born in June 2003. Not more than three people were born after F. We get, May June July 2003 I F 2004 Here, F was born in July 2003. Hence, statement I alone is sufficient. Statement II, Only one friend was born in between H and G. No person was born in between F and H and they were not born in the same year. No person was born in between D and H. We get, Case 1, May June July 2003 F 2004 H D G Case 2, May June July 2003 G D H 2004 F (There are more possibilities) We do not have further information hence statement II alone is not sufficient. Hence, the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question, while the data in statement II alone are not sufficient to answer the question

Question: Eight people sit in two parallel rows. In row-1 P, Q, R and S sit facing towards north and in row-2 E, F, G and H sit facing towards south. Each person in a row faces a person in the other row. Who faces E?
Statements:
(I) F faces an immediate neighbour of S. Only P is between R and S, who is at the extreme end.
(II) Neither S or R faces H. E is between G and H.
o: Data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question.
Data in either statement I or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.
Data in statements I and II together is not sufficient to answer the question.
e: Eight people sit in two parallel rows. In row-1 P, Q, R and S sit facing towards north and in row-2 E, F, G and H sit facing towards south. Each person in a row faces a person in the other row. Statement I: F faces an immediate neighbour of S. Only P is between R and S, who is at the extreme end. Case 1: Row 2 (facing south) F Row 1 (facing north) S P R Q Case 2: Row 2 (facing south) F Row 1 (facing north) Q R P S So, statement I alone is not sufficient. Statement II: Neither S or R faces H. E is between G and H. Case 1: Row 2 (facing south) G/H E G/H F Row 1 (facing north) Case 2: Row 2 (facing south) F G/H E G/H Row 1 (facing north) Case 3: Row 2 (facing south) G/H F E G/H Row 1 (facing north) Case 4: Row 2 (facing south) G/H E F G/H Row 1 (facing north) So, statement II alone is not sufficient. By combining I and II: Neither S or R faces H. Case 1: Row 2 (facing south) F H Row 1 (facing north) S P R Q Case 2: Row 2 (facing south) H F Row 1 (facing north) Q R P S E is between G and H. Case 1: Row 2 (facing south) G F E H Row 1 (facing north) S P R Q Case 2: Row 2 (facing south) H E F G Row 1 (facing north) Q R P S So, R faces E. Thus, both statements I and II together are sufficient.

Question: Anu, Aru, Palak, Riha, Riya and Savi have different heights. Who is the second shortest girl in team?
Statements:
(I) Palak is shorter than Aru and taller than Anu. Riha is taller than Savi.
(II) The height of three girls vary between Aru and Riha. Anu is shorter than Riya.
o: Data in either statement I or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not.
Data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question.
e: Anu, Aru, Palak, Riha, Riya and Savi have different heights. Statement I: Palak is shorter than Aru and taller than Anu. Riha is taller than Savi. Aru > Palak > Anu; Riha > Savi. So, statement I alone is not sufficient. Statement II: The height of three girls vary between Aru and Riha. Anu is shorter than Riya. Aru > ___ > ____> ____> Riha. OR Riha > ___>___ > ____ >Aru. Riya > Anu So, statement II alone is not sufficient. From statements I and II together: Aru/Riha > ___ > ____> ____> Aru/Riha > Savi. Aru > Palak > Anu So, Aru > ___ > ____> ____> Riha > Savi Thus, Riha is the second shortest girl in the team.

Question: After the result, all students of class X are standing in a queue facing north. Some students were passed, some students were failed and some were absent in the exam. How many total students are standing in a queue?
Statements:

The data in Statement (I) alone is sufficient to answer the question, while the data in Statement (II) alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
e: It is given that: After the result, all students of class X are standing in a queue facing north. Some students were passed, some students were failed and some were absent in the exam. From statement I alone: A's rank is 5 th from the top and B's rank is 6 th from the bottom. Three students ranks between A and B. So, 4 students - A (5 th from top) - 3 students - B (6 th from bottom) - 5 students. So, numbers of students that failed in exam is not known. So, statement I alone is not sufficient. From statement II alone: Five students failed in the exam and ten students were absent in the exam. So, the definite conclusion cannot be derived. So, statement II alone is not sufficient. By combining both statements I and II: 4 students - A (5 th from top) - 3 students - B (6 th from bottom) - 5 students. Total students passed are = 4 + A + 3 + B + 5 = 14 students. Five students failed in the exam and ten students were absent in the exam. Thus, total number of students are 14 + 5 + 10 = 29 students.

• कथन इस बात की गारंटी नहीं देता कि जो भी परीक्षा पास करता है, वह नियमित रूप से पढ़ाई करता ही है


• निष्कर्ष नहीं निकाला जा सकता


2. हो सकता है कि रिया ने नियमित रूप से पढ़ाई की हो


• चूँकि परीक्षा पास करने का मतलब यह नहीं है कि नियमित रूप से पढ़ाई की ही गई हो, इसलिए यह संभव है (लेकिन निश्चित नहीं) कि रिया ने नियमित रूप से पढ़ाई की हो


• मान्य निष्कर्ष


3. केवल वही छात्र परीक्षा पास करते हैं जो नियमित रूप से पढ़ाई करते हैं


• कथन कहता है कि सभी नियमित छात्र परीक्षा पास कर लेते हैं, लेकिन यह नहीं कहता कि केवल वही पास करते हैं


• निष्कर्ष नहीं निकाला जा सकता


4. रिया एकमात्र ऐसी छात्रा है जिसने परीक्षा पास की है


• कथन परीक्षा पास करने को केवल रिया तक सीमित नहीं करता है


• निष्कर्ष नहीं निकाला जा सकता

t: A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question. Question: A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting around a circular table. Each of them faces either the centre of the table or outside (i.e., opposite to the centre). In which direction is D facing? Statements: I. B sits second to the right of F and both are facing the centre. Only two people are sitting between A and E from the either sides. Both A and E are facing the same direction. A is not an immediate neighbour of B. II. C is facing the opposite direction of B. D is sitting to the second left of C.
o: Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not.
Statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not.
Statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
e: there is not information about direction in both the statement, no fixed position with respect to direction दोनों कथनों में दिशा के बारे में कोई जानकारी नहीं है , दिशा के संबंध में कोई निश्चित स्थिति नहीं बताई गई है।

t: Given below is a question followed by two statements I and II. Read both the statements carefully to decide which one of them is sufficient to answer the question. Only one person sits between K and N. R sits to the immediate left of N. II. K sits second to the right of Q . Only two people sit between K and M. P sits second to the left of R.
o: Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement Il is not
Data in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not
Data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question .
e: From Statement I – Immediate right of K = R From Statement II - Immediate right of k = R Ans B Either I or II is sufficient कथन I से – K का तत्काल दायाँ भाग = R कथन II से - k का तत्काल दायाँ भाग = R उत्तर B: या तो I या II पर्याप्त है
h: नीचे एक प्रश्न दिया गया है जिसके बाद दो कथन I और II दिए गए हैं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़कर यह तय करें कि कौन सा कथन प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है। छह व्यक्ति - K, M, N, P, Q और R एक गोलाकार मेज के चारों ओर केंद्र की ओर मुख करके बैठे हैं। प्रश्न: K के ठीक दाईं ओर कौन बैठा है? t: A question is given, followed by two statements numbered I. and II. You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and select the appropriate answer. Question: Six people sit in two parallel rows. In Row 1 - J, K and L sit facing towards north, and in Row 2 - F, G and H sit facing towards south. Each person in a row faces a person in the other row. Who faces G? Statements: I. H faces K; L faces an immediate neighbour of H. II. G sits at one of the extreme ends of the row; J sits to the immediate left of L.
o: Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement Il is not
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not
Data in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question
Data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question .
e: Statement I → Statement II → Alone not sufficient By both statement G is facing J Ans D Statement I and II both sufficient कथन I → कथन II → केवल एक कथन पर्याप्त नहीं है दोनों कथनों से G, J की ओर मुख किए हुए है उत्तर D : कथन I और II दोनों पर्याप्त हैं
h: एक प्रश्न दिया गया है, जिसके बाद दो कथन दिए गए हैं, जिन्हें I और II क्रमांकित किया गया है। आपको यह तय करना है कि कथनों में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़ें और उपयुक्त उत्तर चुनें। प्रश्न: छह व्यक्ति दो समानांतर पंक्तियों में बैठे हैं। पंक्ति 1 में J, K और L उत्तर की ओर मुख करके बैठे हैं, और पंक्ति 2 में F, G और H दक्षिण की ओर मुख करके बैठे हैं। प्रत्येक पंक्ति में बैठा व्यक्ति दूसरी पंक्ति में बैठे व्यक्ति के सामने बैठा है। G के सामने कौन बैठा है? कथन: I. H, K के सामने बैठा है; L, H के निकटतम पड़ोसी के सामने बैठा है। II. G पंक्ति के एक छोर पर बैठा है; J, L के ठीक बाईं ओर बैठा है।

A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.
Question : Seven students A, B, C, D, E, F, G are there in a class each of them got different marks in an exam. Who among the following got the lowest score?
Statements : I. C got more marks than D but less than G. F got more marks than A but does not get the highest marks. II. D does not get the lowest marks. E got more marks than B who got more marks than G.
o: Statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not.
Statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not.
e: From statemen I: G>C>D & F>A From statemen II: E>B & B>G. So, E>B > G>C>D Since, D is not the lowest so, E>B > G>C>D > F> A Hence, A got the lowest marks. To find this, we need both the statement. कथन I से : G>C>D और F>A कथन II से : E>B और B>G , तो , E>B > G>C>D चूँकि , D को सबसे कम अंक नहीं मिलते हैं , इसलिए , E>B > G>C>D > F>A अतः , A को सबसे कम अंक मिले। इसे खोजने के लिए हमें दोनों कथनों की आवश्यकता है।
h:
एक प्रश्न दिया गया है, जिसके बाद I और II लेबल वाले दो कथन दिए गए हैं। पहचानें कि कौन सा कथन प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है/हैं।

प्रश्न: एक कक्षा में सात छात्र A, B, C, D, E, F, G हैं, उनमें से प्रत्येक को एक परीक्षा में अलग-अलग अंक मिले हैं। निम्नलिखित में से किसने सबसे कम अंक प्राप्त किये?

कथन:
I. C को D से अधिक अंक मिले हैं लेकिन G से कम अंक मिले हैं। F को A से अधिक अंक मिले हैं लेकिन उसे उच्चतम अंक नहीं मिले हैं।
II. D को सबसे कम अंक नहीं मिलते हैं. E को B से अधिक अंक प्राप्त हुए जिसे G से अधिक अंक प्राप्त हुए।
oh: कथन I और II मिलकर प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं हैं।
अकेले कथन II प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन I नहीं है।
कथन I और II मिलकर प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं।
केवल कथन I ही प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन II नहीं है।
eh:
कथन I से: G>C>D और F>Aकथन II से: E>B और B>G, तो, E>B > G>C>Dचूँकि, D को सबसे कम अंक नहीं मिलते हैं, इसलिए, E>B > G>C>D > F>A

अतः, A को सबसे कम अंक मिले। इसे खोजने के लिए हमें दोनों कथनों की आवश्यकता है।

या तो I अकेला या II अकेला पर्याप्त है।

In a certain code language, 'she drives fast' is coded as 'ta je ne' and 'the long drives' is coded as 'pu je di'. What is the code for the word 'she'?
I. In the same language, 'break the fast' is coded as 'di ta me'.
II. In the same language, 'long tired days' is coded as 'co yi pu'.
o: If the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question
If the data in both statements I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question
If the data in both statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question
e: From I alone: she drives fast == ta je ne the long drives == pu je di break the fast == di ta me So, we get that the code for 'she' is 'ne'. Statement I alone is sufficient. From II alone: she drives fast == ta je ne the long drives == pu je di long tired days == co yi pu We cannot determine the code of 'fast' or 'she'. So, Statement II alone is not sufficient.
h:
नीचे दो कथन क्रमांकित I और II दिए गए हैं। आपको यह निर्धारित करना है कि कथनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं।

I. समान भाषा में 'break the fast' को 'di ta me' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है।
II. समान भाषा में 'long tired days' को 'co yi pu' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है।
oh: यदि अकेले कथन I में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है
यदि एक साथ कथन I और II दोनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है

यदि एक साथ कथन I और II दोनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए आवश्यक है

If the data in both statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question

From II alone: E is older than A. U is younger than O. I is not older than E. E > A, O > U, E > I So, we cannot determine the second youngest person. Statement II alone is not sufficient. From I and II together: A is immediately older than U. E is older than A. O is neither the oldest nor the youngest. E > A >> U U is younger than O. I is not older than E. Case 1: E > O > A > U> I Case 2: E > I/O > O/I > A > U So, we cannot determine the second youngest person. Statements I and II together are not sufficient.

o: Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not

R lives immediately below S on an even numbered floor. Only one floor is between R and T. Two floors are between Q and S. R lives immediately below S on an even numbered floor. Case 1 Case 2 Floor Person Person 6 Q 5 S 4 R 3 S 2 R Q 1 Only one floor is between R and T. Case 1 Case 2 Floor Person Person 6 Q T 5 S 4 T R 3 S 2 R Q 1 We cannot determine floor of S. So, statement I alone is not sufficient. Statement II: Two floors are between R and P. At most two persons live above T. Q lives immediately above P. R lives below S. Case 1 Case 2 Case 3 Case 4 Case 5 Floor Person Person Person Person Person 6 Q R 5 P Q R 4 P Q R 3 P Q 2 R P Q 1 R P We cannot determine floor of S. So, statement II alone is not sufficient. Combining statements I and II: Statement I: Two floors are between Q and S. R lives immediately below S on an even numbered floor. Only one floor is between R and T. Statement II: Two floors are between R and P. At most two persons live above T. Q lives immediately above P. R lives below S. Case 1 Case 2 Floor Person Person 6 Q T 5 P S 4 T R 3 S U 2 R Q 1 U P We cannot determine floor of S. Hence, Statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question

Statement I: Three persons sit between R and U. R sits at the right end of the row. S sits second to the right of U. T sits third to the left of Q. V does not sits adjacent to T.
Statement II: Two persons sit between Q and T. Q sits exactly middle of the row. U sits second to the right of T. P sits fourth to the left of V. S does not sit at the end of the row.
o: Data in statements I and II together is sufficient to answer the question.
Data in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement II is not.
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while data in statement I is not.
e: Statement I: Three persons sit between R and U. R sits at the right end of the row. S sits second to the right of U. T sits third to the left of Q. V does not sits adjacent to T. Three persons sit between R and U. R sits at the right end of the row. S sits second to the right of U. T sits third to the left of Q. V does not sit adjacent to T. Four persons sit between T and V. So, conclusion I alone is sufficient. Statement II: Two persons sit between Q and T. Q sits exactly middle of the row. U sits second to the right of T. P sits fourth to the left of V. S does not sit at the end of the row. Two persons sit between Q and T. Q sits exactly middle of the row. U sits second to the right of T. P sits fourth to the left of V. S does not sit at the end of the row. Four persons sit between T and V. So, conclusion II alone is sufficient. Hence, Data in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.

Question: Eight people sit in two parallel rows. In row 1- A, B, C and D sit facing towards north. In row 2- M, N, O and P sit facing towards south. Each person in a row faces a person in the other row. Who faces N?
Statements:
(I) One person sits between M and P. A faces the one who is immediate left of M.
(II) O is not neighbour of M. B sits to the second right of D.
o: The data in both Statements (I) and (II) together are NOT sufficient to answer the question.
The data in Statement (I) alone is sufficient to answer the question, while the data in Statement (II) alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
The data in Statement (II) alone is sufficient to answer the question, while the data in Statement (I) alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
The data in both the Statements (I) and (II) together are sufficient to answer the question.
e: It is given that: Eight people sit in two parallel rows. In row 1- A, B, C and D sit facing towards north. In row 2- M, N, O and P sit facing towards south. Each person in a row faces a person in the other row. From statement I alone: One person sits between M and P. A faces the one who is immediate left of M. Case 1: Row 2 P M Row 1 A Case 2: Row 2 M P Row 1 A Case 3: Row 2 M P Row 1 A So, statement I alone is not sufficient. From statement II alone: O is not neighbour of M. B sits to the second right of D. Case I: Row 2 Row 1 D B Case II: Row 2 Row 1 D B So, statement II alone is not sufficient. Combining statements I and II together: O is not neighbour of M. Thus, case 1 and case 2 are invalid. Case 3: Row 2 M N P O Row 1 A B sits to the second right of D. Row 2 M N P O Row 1 D A B C Thus, A faces N.
h: इस प्रश्न में, एक प्रश्न के बाद दो कथन क्रमांकित (I) और (II) दिए गए हैं। आपको यह निर्धारित करना है कि कथनों में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं। दोनों कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और अपना उत्तर चुनें। प्रश्न: आठ व्यक्ति दो समानांतर पंक्तियों में बैठे हैं। पंक्ति 1 में A, B, C और D उत्तर की ओर मुखरित होकर बैठे हैं। पंक्ति 2 में M, N, O और P दक्षिण की ओर मुखरित होकर बैठे हैं। एक पंक्ति में बैठा प्रत्येक व्यक्ति, दूसरी पंक्ति में बैठे व्यक्ति की ओर मुखरित है। N की ओर कौन मुखरित है? कथन: (I) M और P के बीच एक व्यक्ति बैठा है। A, M के निकटस्थ बाईं ओर बैठे व्यक्ति की ओर मुखरित है। (II) O, M का पड़ोसी नहीं है। B, D के दाएँ से दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है।
oh: एक साथ कथन (I) और (II) दोनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।

अकेले कथन (II) में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है, जबकि अकेले कथन (I) में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।

A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.
Question:
Seven persons- P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Who among the following sits second to the right of T?
Statements:
(I) S sits third to the right of P. Only one person is sitting between R and S. P sits immediate left of V. Two persons are sitting between Q and U. V does not sit adjacent to Q.
(II) R sits adjacent to T. Three persons are sitting between T and P. S sits second to the left of R. U sits adjacent to S but not adjacent to P.
o: Statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not.
Statement I and II together are sufficient to answer the question
Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not
e: Statement I: S sits third to the right of P. Only one person is sitting between R and S. P sits immediate left of V. Two persons sit between Q and U. V does not sit adjacent to Q. Now, only T is remaining. Q sits second to the right of T. Statement II: R sits adjacent to T. Three persons are sitting between T and P. S sits second to the left of R. U sits adjacent to S but not adjacent to P. We cannot determine who sits second to the right of T. So, statement II is not sufficient. Hence, Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while Statement II is not.
h: एक प्रश्न दिया गया है, उसके बाद I और II से अंकित दो कथन दिए गए हैं। पहचान कीजिए कि कौन सा/से कथन प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है/हैं। प्रश्न: सात व्यक्ति- P, Q, R, S, T, U और V एक गोलाकार मेज के चारों ओर केंद्र के सम्मुख बैठे हैं। निम्नलिखित में से कौन T के दाईं ओर दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है? कथन: (I) S, P के दाईं ओर तीसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। R और S के बीच केवल एक व्यक्ति बैठा है। P, V के ठीक बाईं ओर बैठा है। Q और U के बीच दो व्यक्ति बैठे हैं। V, Q के बगल में नहीं बैठा है। (II) R, T के बगल में बैठा है। T और P के बीच तीन व्यक्ति बैठे हैं। S, R के बाईं ओर दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। U, S के बगल में बैठा है लेकिन P के बगल में नहीं बैठा है।
oh: कथन I और II एकसाथ प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं हैं।
कथन II अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन I अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
कथन I और II एक साथ प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं

I. Two persons are sitting in between R and D. B is sitting second to the left of R. K is sitting second to the right of D.
II. R is sitting second to the left of S. Two persons are sitting in between S and K. H is sitting second to the left of D.
o: If the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question while the data in statement II alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question while the data in statement I alone are not sufficient to answer the question
If the data either in statement I alone or in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question
If the data in both statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question
e: From I alone: Two persons are sitting in between R and D. B is sitting second to the left of R. K is sitting second to the right of D. So, K is sitting to the immediate right of B. So, I alone is sufficient. From II alone: R is sitting second to the left of S. Two persons are sitting in between S and K. H is sitting second to the left of D. So, the 6 th person is B. So, K is sitting to the immediate right of B. So, II alone is sufficient. Hence, either I or II alone is sufficient.

Question:
Eight persons are sitting in two parallel rows with 4 people in each row in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. A, B, C and D sit in row 1 facing the south direction and M, N, O and P sit in row 2 facing the north direction. Who sits opposite to P?
Statements:
(I) B sits second to the left of D. M sits opposite to C. Two persons are sitting between P and O. N sits adjacent to M. A does not sits opposite to P.
(II) Only one person sits between N and P. A sits third to the right of B. D sits opposite to N. M is not an immediate neighbour of O.
o: Statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not
Statement I and II together are sufficient to answer the question
Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not
e: Statement I: B sits second to the left of D. M sits opposite to C. Two persons are sitting between P and O. N sits adjacent to M. A does not sits opposite to P. P sits opposite to either B or D. So, statement I alone is not sufficient. Statement II: Only one person sits between N and P. A sits third to the right of B. D sits opposite to N. M is not an immediate neighbour of O. P is opposite to either A or B. So, statement II alone is not sufficient. Combining statements I and II: Statement I: B sits second to the left of D. M sits opposite to C. Two persons are sitting between P and O. N sits adjacent to M. A does not sits opposite to P. Statement II: Only one person sits between N and P. A sits third to the right of B. D sits opposite to N. M is not an immediate neighbour of O. B sits opposite to P. Hence, Statement I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
h: एक प्रश्न दिया गया है, उसके बाद I और II से अंकित दो कथन दिए गए हैं। पहचान कीजिए कि कौन सा/से कथन प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है/हैं। प्रश्न: आठ व्यक्ति दो समानांतर पंक्तियों में बैठे हैं, प्रत्येक पंक्ति में 4 व्यक्ति इस प्रकार हैं कि आसन्न व्यक्तियों के बीच समान दूरी है। A, B, C और D दक्षिण दिशा के सम्मुख पंक्ति 1 में बैठे हैं और M, N, O और P उत्तर दिशा के सम्मुख पंक्ति 2 में बैठे हैं। P के विपरीत कौन बैठता है? कथन: (I) B, D के बाएं दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। M, C के विपरीत बैठा है। P और O के बीच दो व्यक्ति बैठे हैं। N, M के आसन्न बैठा है। A, P के विपरीत नहीं बैठा है। (II) N और P के बीच केवल एक व्यक्ति बैठा है। A, B के दाएं तीसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। D, N के विपरीत बैठा है। M, O का निकटतम पड़ोसी नहीं है।
oh: कथन I और II एकसाथ प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं हैं।
कथन II अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन I अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है
कथन I और II एक साथ प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं
कथन I अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन II अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है

e: Let the number = n From statement I: When a number is decreased by 20, then it becomes 75% of itself. From statement II: When a number is increased by 25%, then it becomes 5/4 times of itself. Here, (100 + 25)% of n = (5/4) * n From the above equation, value of n cannot be determined. Statement II, 'individual or group' means 'SO GH AM' .............(2.1) 'attain a condition' means 'SW XS LQ' ..........(2.2) We do not have further information hence statement II alone is not sufficient. Hence, the data in both statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question.
h: नीचे दिए गए प्रश्न में एक प्रश्न और उसके नीचे दो कथन क्रमांक I और II दिए गए हैं। आपको यह तय करना है कि कथनों में दी गयी सूचना प्रश्नों का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं। कूट भाषा में 'fame' का क्या अर्थ है? कथन I : 'condition of fame' का अर्थ है 'ES SW RT' और 'box of opportunity' का अर्थ है 'SR ES RA' कथन II : 'individual or group' का अर्थ है 'SO GH AM' और 'attain a condition' का अर्थ है 'SW XS LQ'
oh: यदि अकेले कथन I में दी गयी सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है
यदि अकेले कथन II में दी गयी सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है
यदि एक साथ कथन I और II दोनों में दी गयी सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए आवश्यक है
यदि एक साथ कथन I और II दोनों में दी गयी सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है

t:
A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.
Question: Seven boxes- T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z are kept one above the other but not in the same order. How many boxes are kept above box Y?
Statements:
I. Four boxes are kept between T and Z. At most two boxes are kept above W. Only one box is kept between Z and X. U is kept above V and below Y. Only one box is kept between W and T.
II. Three boxes are kept between W and V. As many persons visited after T as before Z. W is kept above V. Two persons visited between W and T. U is kept below X and above Y.
o: Statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not
Statement I and II together are sufficient to answer the question
e: Seven boxes- T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z are kept one above the other but not in the same order. Statement I: Four boxes are kept between T and Z. At most two boxes are kept above W. Only one box is kept between Z and X. U is kept above V and below Y. Only one box is kept between W and T. At most two boxes are kept above W. Only one box is kept between W and T. Case 1 Case 2 Box Box T W W T Four boxes are kept between T and Z. Only one box is kept between Z and X. Case 1 Box T W X Z U is kept above V and below Y. Box T Y W X U Z V Only one box is kept above box Y. So, only statement I alone is sufficient. Statement II: Three boxes are kept between W and V. As many persons visited after T as before Z. W is kept above V. Two persons visited between W and T. U is kept below X and above Y. Three boxes are kept between W and V. W is kept above V. Case 1 Case 2 Case 3 Box Box Box W W W V V V Two boxes are kept between W and T. As many boxes are below T as above Z. Thus, Case 1 gets cancelled. Case 2 Case 3 Box Box W Z Z W T V T V U is kept below X and above Y. Case 2 Case 3 Box Box X X W Z Z W U U T Y V T Y V We cannot determine how many boxes are kept above box Y. So, statement II is not sufficient. Hence, Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not.
h: एक प्रश्न दिया गया है, उसके बाद I और II से अंकित दो कथन दिए गए हैं। पहचान कीजिए कि कौन सा/से कथन प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है/हैं। प्रश्न: सात डिब्बे- T, U, V, W, X, Y और Z एक के ऊपर एक रखे गए हैं लेकिन इसी क्रम में नहीं। डिब्बा Y के ऊपर कितने डिब्बे रखे हैं? कथन: I. T और Z के बीच चार डिब्बे रखे गए हैं। अधिकतम दो डिब्बे W के ऊपर रखे गए हैं। Z और X के बीच केवल एक डिब्बा रखा गया है। U को V के ऊपर और Y के नीचे रखा गया है। W और T के बीच केवल एक डिब्बा रखा गया है। II. W और V के बीच तीन डिब्बे रखे गए हैं। T के बाद उतने ही व्यक्ति आए जितने Z से पहले आए थे। W को V के ऊपर रखा गया है। W और T के बीच दो व्यक्ति आए हैं। U को X के नीचे और Y के ऊपर रखा गया है।
oh: कथन I और II एकसाथ प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं हैं।
कथन I अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन II अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है
कथन II अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन I अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है
कथन I और II एक साथ प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं

A,B,C,D,E are five members of a family. B is the son of A who is male. C is the only daughter of D. How is E related to D?
I. B is the husband of E. C is not married.
II. E is married to B. C is the sister of B.
o: If the data in statement I alone are sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in both statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in both statement I and II together are necessary to answer the question.
e: Considering statement I: B is the husband of E. C is not married. So statement I alone is not sufficient. Considering statement II: E is married to B. C is the sister of B. So E is the daughter in law of A. Hence statement II alone is sufficient.
h:

I. B, E का पति है। C विवाहित नहीं है।
II. E का विवाह B से हुआ है। C, B की बहन है।
oh: यदि अकेले कथन I में दी गयी सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।
यदि अकेले कथन II में दी गयी सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।
यदि एक साथ कथन I और II दोनों में दी गयी सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
यदि एक साथ कथन I और II दोनों में दी गयी सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए आवश्यक है।

t:
Given below a question and two statements numbered (I) and (II). You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements is sufficient to answer the question.
Find the sum of an arithmetic progression.
I. Total number of terms in the progression is 8. And the last term is 22.
II. The first term is 1.
o: If the data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while the data in statement I is not sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in both the statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in both the statements I and II together not sufficient to answer the question.
If the data either in statement I alone or in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question.
e: From statement I: n = 8 and last term (l) = 22 No information about the first term (a) or common difference (d). Hence, statement I alone is not sufficient. From statement II: First term (a) = 1 No information about n or l or d. Hence, statement II alone is not sufficient. From both statements I and II together: a = 1, l = 22, n = 8 Sum = n/2 (a + l) = 8/2 (1 + 22)= 4 23 = 92 Hence, both statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
h:
नीचे एक प्रश्न और (I) तथा (II) क्रमांकित दो कथन दिए गए हैं। आपको यह तय करना है कि कथनों में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं।
एक समान्तर श्रेणी का योगफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

oh: यदि कथन II में दिया गया डाटा अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है जबकि कथन I में दिया गया डाटा अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
यदि कथन I और II दोनों में दिया गया डाटा प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।
यदि कथन I और II दोनों में दिया गया डाटा प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
यदि या तो कथन I या कथन II में दिया गया डाटा अकेले प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।

Two statements are numbered I and II are given below. You have to decide whether the data given in the statements are sufficient to answer the question.
Six people A,B,C,D,E,F are seated in a linear row facing north. Who is seated at the left end of the row?
I. B is seated second to the left of A. D is seated third to the right of B. E is seated to the immediate left of F.
II. E is seated second to the left of B. F is seated to the left of C. A is seated to the immediate left of D.
o: If the data in statement I alone are sufficient.
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient.
If the data in statement I and statement II together are necessary to answer the question.
If the data in statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
e: Considering statement I: B is seated second to the left of A. D is seated third to the right of B. E is seated to the immediate left of F. So statement I alone is not sufficient. Considering statement II: E is seated second to the left of B. F is seated to the left of C. A is seated to the immediate left of D. So statement II alone is not sufficient. Combining both the statements: So E is seated at the left end of the row.
h:

छह व्यक्ति A,B,C,D,E,F एक रेखीय पंक्ति में उत्तर की ओर मुखरित होकर बैठे हैं। पंक्ति के बाईं छोर पर कौन-सा व्यक्ति बैठा है?
I. B, A के बाईं ओर से दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। D, B के दाईं ओर से तीसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। E, F के निकटस्थ बाईं ओर बैठा है।
II. E, B के बाईं ओर से दूसरे स्थान पर बैठा है। F, C के बाईं ओर बैठा है। A, D के निकटस्थ बाईं ओर बैठा है।
oh: यदि अकेले कथन I की सूचना पर्याप्त है।
यदि अकेले कथन II की सूचना पर्याप्त है।

Each of the questions below consists of a question and two statements numbered I and II given below it. You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements are sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and give the answer.
What does 'from' means in a code language?
Statement I: 'message from body' is coded as 'one three four' and 'blood from the veins' is coded as 'seven six eight four'
Statement II: 'lesson from brain' is coded as 'four ten nine' and 'rise from the ashes' is coded as 'six two four five'
o: If the data in both statement I and statement II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question.
If the data in either in statement I alone or statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question.
e: From Statement I- 'message from body' is coded as 'one three four' 'blood from the veins' is coded as 'seven six eight four' The code for- From = four So, Statement I alone is sufficient. From Statement II- 'lesson from brain' is coded as 'four ten nine' 'rise from the ashes' is coded as 'six two four five' The code for- From = four So, Statement II alone is sufficient. Thus, the data in either statement I alone or statement II alone are sufficient to answer the question.
h:
नीचे दिए गए प्रत्येक प्रश्न में एक प्रश्न और उसके नीचे दो कथन क्रमांकित I और II दिए गए हैं। आपको यह निर्धारित करना है कि कथनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त हैं या नहीं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़िए और उत्तर दीजिए।
एक कोड भाषा में 'from' का क्या अर्थ है?
कथन I: 'message from body' को 'one three four' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है और 'blood from the veins' को 'seven six eight four' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है।
कथन II: 'lesson from brain' को 'four ten nine' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है और 'rise from the ashes' को 'six two four five' के रूप में कोडित किया गया है।
oh: यदि एक साथ कथन I और कथन II दोनों में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
यदि अकेले कथन II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।
यदि अकेले कथन I में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।
यदि या तो अकेले कथन I या अकेले कथन II में दी गई सूचना प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।

t:
Each of the questions below consists of a question and two statements numbered I and II given below it. You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements are sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and give answer:
What is the selling price of the article?
Statement I: The difference between the selling price and cost price of the article is Rs. 123.
Statement II: The cost price of the article is Rs. 820 and the profit earned is 15%.
o: Data in either statement I alone or statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.
Data in statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question, while data in statement II alone is not sufficient.
Data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question, while data in statement I alone is not sufficient.
Data in statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
e: I. S.P - C.P = Rs. 123 Not sufficient II. S.P = C.P * (100 + Profit)/100 = 820 * (100 + 15)/100 = Rs. 943 Sufficient.
h:
नीचे दिए गए प्रत्येक प्रश्न में एक प्रश्न और उसके नीचे I और II से अंकित दो कथन दिए गए हैं। आपको निर्णय करना है कि कथनों में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है या नहीं। दोनों कथनों को पढ़िए और उत्तर दीजिए:
वस्तु का विक्रय मूल्य क्या है?
कथन I: वस्तु के विक्रय मूल्य और क्रय मूल्य के बीच का अंतर 123 रुपये है।
कथन II: वस्तु का क्रय मूल्य 820 रुपये है और अर्जित लाभ 15% है।
oh: प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए या तो कथन I या कथन II में दी गई जानकारी अकेले पर्याप्त है।
अकेले कथन I में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है, जबकि अकेले कथन II में दी गई जानकारी पर्याप्त नहीं है।
अकेले कथन II में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है, जबकि अकेले कथन I में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त नहीं है।
कथन I और II में दी गई जानकारी प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है।

t:
A question is given, followed by two statements labelled I and II. Identify which of the statements is/are sufficient to answer the question.
Question:
Eight persons- P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the inside the centre but not in the same order. Who among the following sits fourth to the right of R.
Statements:
I. Three persons sit between Q and V. S sits second to the right of U. V sits adjacent to S.
II. P sits immediate right of T. Two persons sit between S and P. R sits second to the right of W.
o: Statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not
Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not
Statement I and II together are sufficient to answer the question
e: Eight persons- P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the inside the centre but not in the same order. Statement I: Three persons sit between Q and V. S sits second to the right of U. V sits adjacent to S. There is no information about R. So, statement I is not sufficient. Statement II: P sits immediate right of T. Two persons sit between S and P. R sits second to the right of W. We cannot exactly determine who sits fourth to the right of R. So, statement II is not sufficient. Combining statement I and statement II: Statement I: Three persons sit between Q and V. S sits second to the right of U. V sits adjacent to S. Statement II: P sits immediate right of T. Question:
Six persons are sitting in two parallel rows with 3 people in each row in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. L, M and N sit in row 1 facing the south direction and X, Y and Z sit in row 2 facing the north direction. Who sits opposite to L?
Statements:
(I) M sits adjacent to N. Y sits opposite to the one who sits immediate left of N. Y does not sits adjacent to Z.
(II) Only one person sits between L and M. The one who sits opposite to X sits immediate right of L. M does not sits opposite to Y.
o: Statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not
Statement I and II together are sufficient to answer the question
Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not
e: Six persons are sitting in two parallel rows with 3 people in each row in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons. L, M and N sit in row 1 facing the south direction and X, Y and Z sit in row 2 facing the north direction. Statement I: M sits adjacent to N. Y sits opposite to the one who sits immediate left of N. Y does not sits adjacent to Z. L sits opposite to either Z or Y. So, statement I alone is not sufficient. Statement II: Only one person sits between L and M. The one who sits opposite to X sits immediate right of L. M does not sits opposite to Y. Now, only N is remaining. Y sits opposite to L. Question below consists of a question and two statements numbered I and II given below it. You have to decide whether the data provided in the statements are sufficient to answer the question. Read both the statements and give answer:
Find the total cost of item A, B and C together.
Statement I: Average cost of item A and B together is ₹40.
Statement II: The ratio of cost of item A and C is 3:2 respectively.
o: Statement I alone is sufficient while statement II alone is not sufficient.
Statement II alone is sufficient while statement I alone is not sufficient.
Neither Statement I alone nor statement II alone is sufficient.
Statement I and II together are sufficient.
e: From I: Average cost of item A and B together = ₹40 Total cost of item A and B together = 2*40 = ₹80 Data given is not sufficient. From II: Cost of item A/Cost of item C = 3/2 Data given is not sufficient. From I and II together: A + B = ₹80 A = 3C/2 3C/2 + B = 80 3C + 2B = 160 Data given is not sufficient. Hence, option 'c' is correct.

Five persons - A, D, H, K and M scored different marks in an exam. Who among the following scored the lowest marks?
Statements:
I. K scored less marks than D but more marks than M. A scored more marks than D. H scored less marks than M.
II. A scored more marks than M. D did not score highest marks. K scored more marks than M but less marks than D.
o: Statement I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
Statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement I is not.
Statements I and II together are sufficient to answer the question.
Statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not.
e: Five persons - A, D, H, K and M scored different marks in an exam. Statement (I): K scored less marks than D but more marks than M. A scored more marks than D. H scored less marks than M. Person Highest A D K M Lowest H H scored the lowest marks. Statement (II): A scored more marks than M. D did not score highest marks. K scored more marks than M but less marks than D. Person Person Person Person Person Person Person Highest A A H A H H A D D D D D A H K K K H A D D M H A K K K K Lowest H M M M M M M Either H or M scored the lowest marks. So, statement II is not sufficient. Hence, statement I alone is sufficient to answer the question while statement II is not.
h: एक प्रश्न दिया गया है, जिसके बाद I और II के रूप में लेबल किए गए दो कथन दिए गए हैं। पहचानें कि कौन-सा/से कथन प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए पर्याप्त है/हैं। प्रश्न: पाँच व्यक्ति - A, D, H, K और M ने एक परीक्षा में अलग-अलग अंक प्राप्त किए। निम्नलिखित में से किसने सबसे कम अंक प्राप्त किए? कथन: I. K ने D से कम अंक प्राप्त किए लेकिन M से अधिक अंक प्राप्त किए। A ने D से अधिक अंक प्राप्त किए। H ने M से कम अंक प्राप्त किए। II. A ने M से अधिक अंक प्राप्त किए। D ने सबसे अधिक अंक प्राप्त नहीं किए। K ने M से अधिक अंक प्राप्त किए लेकिन D से कम अंक प्राप्त किए।

(ii) S is the mother of B. Q is the sister of A. D is the wife of A.
o: Both (i) and (ii) together are needed

e: Statement (i): A is the father of P. Q is the daughter of S. P is the sibling of Q. A is the husband of S. Statement (ii): S is the mother of B. Q is the sister of A. D is the wife of A. There is no relation between A and S. So, statement (ii) alone is not sufficient. Hence, (i) alone is sufficient while (ii) alone is not sufficient

Statement II: She sold all the saris to his relatives at Rs. 64000.
o: If the data in both statements I and II together are necessary to answer the question.
If the data in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question, while the data in statement I alone is not sufficient to answer the question.
If the data given in both statements, I and II together are not sufficient to answer the question.
If the data either in statement I alone or in statement II alone is sufficient to answer the question.
e: From I: Cost price of the saris = Rs. 48000 But from these data we cannot find the answer. From II: Selling price of the saris = Rs. 64000 But from these data we cannot find the answer. From I and II: SP = 64000 and CP = 48000 So, profit % = (64000 - 48000)/48000 * 100 = 33.33% Hence, statement I and II together are sufficient.

कथन I: उसने सभी साड़ियाँ थोक बाजार से 48000 रुपये में खरीदीं।
कथन II: उसने सभी साड़ियाँ अपने रिश्तेदारों को 64000 रुपये में बेचीं।
oh: यदि प्रश्न का उत्तर देने के लिए कथन 1 और 2 दोनों में दिए गए आंकड़े एक साथ आवश्यक हों।
